name: WfmCompetingAttemptReviewProposalAlgorithm
inputs: one immutable published valid wfm_service_provider observation
current LLD-03 canonical parent RFC identity
preconditions: observation identity is exact TK+14 under exact NC+14
planned_start and planned_end are both usable validated whole-second UTC instants with end>start
task_no_status is ACTIVE and get_by_task_no resolves one current WFM Task under the exact current parent RFC
subject Task already has reviewed activity-lineage authority; absence of reviewed lineage cannot produce this proposal
algorithm: if classification is not SAME_REVIEWED_LINEAGE_OVERLAP emit no wfm_competing_attempt_review
require suggested_counterpart_task_id nonnull and exact_conflict_count>=1; the provider has already selected the lowest task_id UTF-8 from the complete hidden conflict set

emit exactly one smallest-safe-scope proposal using proposal_kind=wfm_competing_attempt_review,risk=high,evidence_mode=observed_row,target_kind=activity_lineage,target_internal_id=activity_lineage_id,target_business_id=subject task_no,source_observation_id=the exact WFM observation,base_state_token_sha256=the complete conflict_fingerprint

the proposal contains exactly one ordinal-0 change {field_key:'competing_attempt_counterpart',change_kind:'conflict',value_kind:'identity',before_text:null,after_text:suggested_counterpart_task_id,before_integer:null,after_integer:null,source_observation_field_id:null}
proposal_fingerprint_sha256 is exactly sha256_canonical_json(SOMA_IMPORT_PROPOSAL_FINGERPRINT_V1) as pinned below; it is independent from base_state_token_sha256 and from any operator decision

if a materially equivalent still-pending proposal for the same subject observation/activity_lineage/suggested counterpart/base conflict fingerprint already exists, deterministic proposal generation reuses/no-changes according to the existing equivalence rules rather than duplicating review authority

proposal_fingerprint.canonicalization: LLD-01 strict canonical JSON SHA-256 through sha256_canonical_json; no alternate serialization is permitted

source.source_family: exact import_runs.source_family and source_observations.source_family; wfm_service_provider for this algorithm

proposal.target_internal_id: exact reviewed activity_lineage_id returned by WfmImportReader.activity_conflicts

proposal_fingerprint.ordering: changes are ordered by ordinal ascending; this proposal has exactly ordinal 0. Object key order is supplied only by strict canonical JSON and never by insertion order.
proposal_fingerprint.separation_rule: proposal_fingerprint_sha256 proves immutable source/proposal evidence. base_state_token_sha256 separately proves mutable current conflict authority. An equal proposal fingerprint with a changed base token is stale current-state authority, not rewritten source evidence.

rules: mere time overlap, same RFC, same Task Name, same Customer, same source status, or source-plan similarity never establishes same activity
ABSENT or RETIRED Task No, missing reviewed lineage, different lineage, blank/partial/malformed plan evidence, or locally terminal execution/outcome cannot emit this proposal

source projection acceptance and activity-lineage review are independent. A newly observed candidate interval may generate the review proposal, but dedicated resolution requires that exact source observation to have become the current accepted LLD-05 source projection before the review can be accepted

the complete conflict_fingerprint may bind more conflicts than the one deterministic suggested counterpart; any relevant set/member authority drift stales the proposal. After one reviewed relationship changes, refreshed reconciliation may surface another remaining conflict under a new fingerprint

proposal resolution never changes provider source evidence, WFM identity, operational plan, execution/outcome, Objective membership or TK identity except for LLD-05 lineage authority explicitly selected by the operator
